newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungarian forint remains steady vs dollar, basket.
newsitem.headline: Hungarian forint remains steady vs dollar, basket.

text.p: The Hungarian forint closed virtually unchanged against the dollar and remained stuck on the central bank bid on Monday, dealers said.
The forint closed at 180.37/42 to the dollar, compared to 180.30/35 at the opening.
In the lack of domestic factors the forint followed the dollar/mark movements but the international crosses gave little impetus also as the dollar/mark remained rangebound.
"There were not any movements, everything remained rangebound," said Peter Luczo of Inter-Europa Bank.
